SELECT CONCAT(dp.distribution_product_id, '-', rc.room_category_id, '-', cb.channel_id) AS productId, CONCAT(dp.distribution_product_id, '-', rc.room_category_id, '-', cb.channel_id) AS id, gm.name AS title, gm.name AS productName, CAST(rc.room_category_id AS CHAR) AS roomCategoryId, rc.name AS roomCategoryName, CAST(cb.channel_id AS CHAR) AS channelId, cb.channel_name AS channelName, COALESCE(gm.stock, 0) AS stock, gm.selling_price_cent AS salePrice, GREATEST(COALESCE(gm.original_price_cent, gm.selling_price_cent) - gm.selling_price_cent, 0) AS extraPrice, DATE_FORMAT(gm.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(gm.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt, gm.status AS status, gm.reservation_phone AS reservationPhone, gm.reservation_note AS reservationNote
ORDER BY dp.distribution_product_id ASC, rc.room_category_id ASC, cb.sort_account_id ASC, cb.channel_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
